reason: Both sell packaged better-for-you food in North America through grocery, club and e-commerce channels. SunOpta mainly makes plant-based beverages, broths and ingredients, often for customers' brands. It also makes some better-for-you snacks and nutritional beverages. Simply Good Foods owns brands of nutrition bars, shakes and snacks. The channels overlap, but the core products and the business model differ, so this is adjacent rather than direct.
